parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the BDS cluster. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~144595~~) operation to obtain the cluster ID.

parameters.name: HaActive
parameters.description: The instance ID of the primary instance.

parameters.name: HaActiveClusterKey
parameters.description: The ZooKeeper address of the primary instance. This parameter is required when the primary instance is a non-standard instance (IsActiveStandard is set to false).

parameters.name: HaActiveDBType
parameters.description: The cluster type of the primary instance. Valid values: **HBase** and **HBaseue**.

parameters.name: HaActiveHbaseFsDir
parameters.description: The HDFS directory of the primary instance. This parameter is required when the primary instance is a non-standard instance (IsActiveStandard is set to false).

parameters.name: HaActiveHdfsUri
parameters.description: The HDFS URI of the primary instance. This parameter is required when the primary instance is a non-standard instance (IsActiveStandard is set to false).

parameters.name: HaActivePassword
parameters.description: The password that corresponds to the username of the primary instance. This parameter is required when the primary instance is **HBaseue**.

parameters.name: HaActiveUser
parameters.description: The username of the primary instance. This parameter is required when the primary instance is **HBaseue**.

parameters.name: HaActiveVersion
parameters.description:
The database engine version of the primary instance. This parameter is required when the primary instance is a non-standard instance (IsActiveStandard is set to false). Valid values:
- **HBase1x**: HBase 1.x.
- **HBase2x**: HBase 2.x.
- **HBaseUE**: HBaseue.

parameters.name: HaMigrateType
parameters.description:
The synchronization type. Valid values:
- **CLUSTER**: instance-level synchronization.
- **TABLE**: table-level synchronization.
- **SKIP**: no synchronization required.

parameters.name: HaStandby
parameters.description: The ID of the secondary instance cluster.

parameters.name: HaStandbyClusterKey
parameters.description: The ZooKeeper address of the secondary instance. This parameter is required when the secondary instance is a non-standard instance (IsStandbyStandard is set to false).

parameters.name: HaStandbyDBType
parameters.description: The cluster type of the secondary instance. Valid values: **HBase** and **HBaseue**.

parameters.name: HaStandbyHbaseFsDir
parameters.description: The HDFS directory of the secondary instance. This parameter is required when the secondary instance is a non-standard instance (IsStandbyStandard is set to false).

parameters.name: HaStandbyHdfsUri
parameters.description: The HDFS URI of the secondary instance. This parameter is required when the secondary instance is a non-standard instance (IsStandbyStandard is set to false).

parameters.name: HaStandbyPassword
parameters.description: The password that corresponds to the username of the secondary instance. This parameter is required when the secondary instance is **hbaseue**.

parameters.name: HaStandbyUser
parameters.description: The username of the secondary instance. This parameter is required when the secondary instance is **hbaseue**.

parameters.name: HaStandbyVersion
parameters.description:
The database engine version of the secondary instance. This parameter is required when the secondary instance is a non-standard instance (IsStandbyStandard is set to false). Valid values:
- **HBase1x**: HBase 1.x.
- **HBase2x**: HBase 2.x.
- **HBaseUE**: HBaseue.

parameters.name: HaTables
parameters.description: The tables to synchronize. This parameter is required when HaMigrateType is set to TABLE. Separate multiple tables with commas (,).

parameters.name: IsActiveStandard
parameters.description: Specifies whether the primary instance is a standard instance. Set this parameter to **true** for a standard instance.

parameters.name: IsStandbyStandard
parameters.description: Specifies whether the secondary instance is a standard instance. Set this parameter to **true** for a standard instance.
